recorded: 2026-10-30, after the judges' panel (run 1 of 5; all five in runs.json)
model: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API), the photo marking prompt in witness/src/witness_photo.erl, the fingerprint rule in witness_mark:fingerprint/4
prompt: the rule quotes none of the three answers (its one example is from another topic)
paper: sample paper made for the demo (not a real student): Year 9 Mathematics, Percentages and Money, 2 pages, a handwriting font on a simulated phone photo
steps_as_read: Half up, half down. Same price.

fingerprint.ask: Write or say what you had after each step, and how you got it.
evidence: Half up, half down. Same price.
fingerprint.intervention: Have the student predict then work out $100 up 50% to $150, then down 50% from $150 step-by-step and compare the $75 result to their same-price prediction.
fingerprint.reasoning: Thinks +50% then -50% cancel because one is half up and the other half down, leaving the same price.
